_: U15 promotion allowlist (coordinator ruling 2026-11-15): the ONLY library versions that may be copied from an owner-run fetch into the production store (`$DATA_DIR/pine_libraries`).

A version is listed under `promote` only when EVERY capture of every newly-attaching importing script in the U15 sample (65 scripts, 132 captures) grades MATCH with it linked AND WITH THE RUNTIME PANE OFF (`hostOnly`), and its licence is not non-commercial. The runtime pane is off for members, so the host lane's picture is the one a promoted library would draw.
Each version is pinned by the sha256 of the source that was graded: promote exactly that code, never a re-fetch with another sha.
Non-commercial (CC-BY-NC*) libraries are never promoted (the store refuses to serve them: pine:library-licence).

Promotion is a separate, coordinator-authorised step after U15 Phase A merges. Nothing in this file enables anything: no store is written by it. Measured 2026-11-15 on the local store (docs/pine/evidence/2026-11-15-u15-library-pinning/EVIDENCE.md, P0 and the host-only re-grade).
tests/test_pine_library_pinning.py holds this file to its own rule (every promoted row: a sha256, a licence the store serves, not on the deny list, and every hostOnly capture MATCH).
